column1: # The 1980s and 1990s, curated on 25 October 2026 from decks/harvest-1980s-1990s-2026-10-25.tsv.
# The deck had eleven 1980s songs and twenty-six 1990s songs, and the game now
# deals evenly across eras, so those two decades repeated within an evening.
# Deezer's own dates are reissue and upload dates for almost everything here, so
# every year was taken from somewhere else and the note beside it says where:
# the original cassette, LP or CD on Discogs; the African Cassettes archive at
# Mainz University (african-cassettes.uni-mainz.de), which catalogues the
# cassettes themselves; Wikipedia discographies; or the artist's own dated
# releases. Ethiopian cassettes carry Ethiopian-calendar years, which run from
# September to September, seven or eight years behind; a year converted from one
# is written as such and is never marked confirmed.
# A note that starts with "confirmed" marks a year a documented release settles,
# and `import` takes that row as confirmed. Every other year is a proposal for
# /deck. Where Deezer only has a later re-recording of a song, the note says so
# and the year is still the song's.
#     python tools/build_deck.py import decks/amharic-1980s-1990s.tsv --by harvest
# year <TAB> artist_latin <TAB> title_latin <TAB> artist_am <TAB> title_am <TAB> youtube_url <TAB> deezer_track_id <TAB> # note
